_meta.notes: Fable 5 + Mythos 5 are TWO CONFIGURATIONS of the same underlying model from Anthropic (2026-06-09). Fable 5 = safeguards ON (general API), Mythos 5 = safeguards LIFTED (Project Glasswing partners only). Pricing: $10/M input, $50/M output (~half of Mythos Preview). 9 NEW SOTAs across SWE/cyber/bio/agent/OS domains. NEW benchmarks: FrontierCode (Cognition Diamond/Main subsets), GDP.pdf (Surge AI multimodal expert reasoning). Fable 5 also wins GDPval-AA leaderboard (top score, +42 Elo over Opus 4.8). Mythos 5 BrowseComp 88.0% (impressive but GPT-5.5 Pro 90.1 still leads).

benchmarks.name: FrontierCode (Diamond subset, Cognition)
benchmarks.description: Agentic coding benchmark of 150 SE tasks derived from open-source PRs. Diamond = harder subset. Patch correctness rate (mean@5).

benchmarks.name: FrontierCode (Main subset, Cognition)
benchmarks.description: Agentic coding benchmark Main subset. Patch correctness rate (mean@5).

benchmarks.name: GDP.pdf (Surge AI multimodal expert PDF reasoning)
benchmarks.description: 100 real-world prompts and PDFs from professional workflows across 10 domains (finance, healthcare, legal, engineering, insurance). Strict pass rate, no tools.

benchmarks.name: Toolathlon Pass³ (3-trial consistency)
benchmarks.description: Toolathlon reliability metric — fraction of tasks solved in ALL 3 trials. Tests consistency of tool-use success.
